evidence.claim: Ookla says that when the app is in use (or running in the background) it collects and shares precise location data of the device, Wi-Fi signals or Bluetooth Low Energy devices nearby, device-based advertising identifiers, app names/identifiers and device information (type, OS, settings, time zone, carrier, IP address) in connection with its partner Outlogic.

Ookla says it and third parties, subject to your privacy choices, may collect data about your behavior while using its services to provide interest-based advertising on other websites and applications.
Ookla says Weplan Analytics measures network performance linked with location data (GPS or network-based) in a pseudonymized manner.
Ookla says that under some circumstances it may sell or share personal data you provide to serve interest-aligned ads.
Users can opt out of selling or sharing via Ookla's Privacy Portal or by email, and can opt out of its location data provider Outlogic on Outlogic's privacy choices page.
Ookla says it retains personal information as long as necessary for the purposes in its policy and as applicable law allows.

Ookla says the app can collect and share precise location and device data (including while running in the background) with location partners such as Outlogic, and that it may sell or share personal data for interest-aligned ads; opt-outs are offered through its privacy portal and Outlogic.

Ookla lists purposes for the Outlogic data including customizing and measuring ads, app and user analytics, disease prevention and cybersecurity, research on aggregated foot traffic, and generating pseudonymized identifiers.

Ookla says a partner (HUQ) collects information including latitude, longitude, accuracy, network names and scanned networks on an anonymous basis, and that this anonymous information is shared with third parties for their business purposes, including reports, market research and trend analysis.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 7.1.0 (report dated Sept. 11, 2026) found code signatures for 11 known tracker SDK(s): Amazon Advertisement, Amazon Mobile Analytics (Amplify) (analytics), ComScore (analytics advertisement), Google AdMob (advertisement), Google Analytics (analytics), Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), Google Tag Manager (analytics), Huawei Mobile Services (HMS) Core (analytics advertisement location), IAB Open Measurement (identification advertisement), Prebid Mobile (advertisement). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
